items.title: Harold Ousley interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 12, 2001
items.q: my first musical role models and heroes were Gene Ammons and Lester Young, and of course Coleman Hawkins and Charlie Parker as the years went on

ctx.x: And what would your song list include for those kinds of gigs?

Well you know my first musical role models and heroes were Gene Ammons and Lester Young, and of course Coleman Hawkins and Charlie Parker as the years went on. But the first people I guess that I really began to relate to was Gene Ammons because he was there in Chicago. And then of course Lester Young was very popular at the time and there was a lot of records out.
